records.rationale: Full three-path patch read. Keep timer target source hook to support vendor placement/pause policy. Native hrtimer get_target_base immediately indexes per-CPU bases using this result; even done=false leaves cpu as the seed for domain lookup. Adapt both paths to reject out-of-range/offline CPU and restore actual-current seed with done=false. Accept completed override only in current native HK_TYPE_KERNEL_NOISE housekeeping policy; a valid non-housekeeping seed falls through native search. Preserve valid done=false seed changes and accepted idle/busy policy overrides. Full unhooked selector and both timer consumer functions remain native LTS. No specific SDK callback or CPU-pause implementation is established; retain generic capability.

records.rationale: Full three-path effective-clamp addition read; title/body discussion of removing a different hook is not an actual deletion in this patch. Preserve override ret!=0 bypassing native task-group/system maximum policy and mutable uc_max affecting normal return. Initialize uc_eff explicitly to zero, matching selected SDK automatic stack zeroing, then derive every callback-returned bucket index from its value. Native documented value-to-bucket relation and uclamp_rq_inc_id indexed writes require this invariant; values, including representable values above capacity, remain unbounded by this adaptation to preserve policy customization. Partial value-only callbacks and malformed bucket fields no longer yield stale/invalid indices. Native permission/LSM authorization is outside this calculation and not weakened.

records.rationale: Full three-path estimator hook read. Preserve early callback before UTIL_EST and task_sleep gates; any nonzero ret skips native estimate update, and callback can maintain alternative estimate. Keep current native unsigned EWMA, activation/unchanged checks, fast ramp-up, runnable-underestimate check, averaging and final flag/trace; entire function equals LTS after callback block removal. Called on fair dequeue before dequeue_entities and after optional util_est_dequeue; delayed-task handling remains native. Override can intentionally leave stale estimates or change frequency decisions; trusted callback must keep accounting consistent, no measured SDK benefit or known installed implementation asserted.

records.rationale: Full five-path patch read. Keep six-word task OEM storage as functional source-extension state, final four-argument placement notification and scheduler-domain-built notification after successful attach/static-key updates. Preserve current three-argument task replacement hook and donor-change retry guards, not old task/entity/repick/simple outputs. Historical wakeup-ignore interface was explicitly removed by 5d1a9a9aa581 (full deletion read); current evolved preempt/nopreempt hook is separately preserved. Historical check_preempt_tick has retained declaration/export but no current call site; do not resurrect obsolete CFS slice algorithm into LTS EEVDF. Place callback receives pointer to local vruntime after native entity store; writing only that local does not change already stored vruntime. Domain callback reports success before allocation cleanup, no failure event.

records.rationale: Full five-path patch read. Preserve task-free, post-class enqueue/dequeue, entity-tree, entity-tick and fair hierarchy events using final signatures. Free callback occurs after cpufreq-state, affinity-mask and shadow-stack release but before task-object release: cannot use released resources or retain task without valid lifetime protocol. Entity callbacks run before native augmented-tree/weighted-vruntime changes, and must not independently corrupt membership. Tick event is after accounting and skipped by queued-HRTICK early return. Fair events occur between hierarchy loops with transformed flags, not guaranteed original flags; dequeue event moved to dequeue_entities, can see p=NULL for group entities, and is skipped by some delayed/early paths. Current post-dequeue callback receives writable bool result, so callback must keep actual queue/delay state consistent. Final task-replacement and wakeup-preemption protocols supersede six-argument/obsolete buddy/granularity extensions. Retained check_preempt_tick declaration/export currently emits no event. No historical layout preservation required.
